subject: Ciências
description_pt: Discutir as ideias de Mendel sobre hereditariedade (fatores hereditários, segregação, gametas, fecundação), considerando-as para resolver problemas envolvendo a transmissão de características hereditárias em diferentes organismos.

components.description_pt: Explicar os conceitos de Mendel de fatores hereditários, segregação, gametas e fertilização
components.description_en: Explain Mendel's concepts of hereditary factors, segregation, gametes, and fertilization
components.cc_component_description: Explain how meiosis and fertilization contribute to genetic variation in sexually reproducing organisms

components.description_pt: Aplicar conceitos de probabilidade para prever a distribuição de traços em uma população entre gerações
components.description_en: Apply probability concepts to predict the distribution of traits in a population across generations
components.cc_component_description: Apply probability concepts to predict the distribution of traits in a population across generations

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo a transmissão de traços hereditários em diferentes organismos usando princípios mendelianos
components.description_en: Solve problems involving the transmission of hereditary traits in different organisms using Mendelian principles
components.cc_component_description: Apply probability concepts to predict the distribution of traits in a population across generations

cc_matches.description: Apply concepts of statistics and probability to explain the variation and distribution of expressed traits in a population.
Develop and use a model to describe why asexual reproduction results in offspring with identical genetic information and sexual reproduction results in offspring with genetic variation.
